mentions.name: Cosmo Cargo

mentions.source_excerpt:
A modern take on the game FTL: Faster Than Light, with inventory autobattler gameplay.
It is called Cosmo Cargo and a demo is available on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4659480/Cosmo_Cargo_Demo/
